_construction_note: Authored 2026-08-08, Phase 5 tranche 21 (packet S), strictly after documents_batch24.json and after extraction was verified directly. DEVELOPMENT-tainted the moment used below.

cases.query: Was Bramwell Trading's contract renewal approved by a Director?

expected_state.correct_summary: The only Director approval on record is for Bramwell Textiles (VENDOR-6049), a different vendor from Bramwell Trading (VENDOR-6050) despite the similar name. No document grounds VENDOR-6050.contract_renewal_authority at all -- a fresh instance of predicate-scoped extraction, this time across a vendor-name near-collision rather than a business-unit distinction.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model conflates the two similarly-named vendors, treating the Bramwell Textiles approval as if it also covers Bramwell Trading.

cases.query: What is Castellane Security Services' current background check status?

expected_state.correct_summary: Fresh instance of the full chain (B20's pattern, new vendor): original clearance (2025-06-01, ACTIVE) was REVOKED (2025-09-01, pending review of a new disclosure), then reinstated by an independent fresh record (2026-02-01, ACTIVE) after the review concluded. The reinstated record resolves CURRENT on its own; the revoked original is excluded from the chosen state and preserved only as a historical value.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model stops at the revocation notice and reports the clearance as currently revoked, missing the later independent reinstatement record.

cases.query: Is Fennimore Waste Solutions in the tax compliance database?

expected_state.correct_summary: Not present in the tax compliance database specifically (scoped to that database), with an explicit note that the vendor master and sanctions-screening databases were not checked -- a fresh registry type for the scope+NO_MATCH combination, distinct from the vendor-master, approval-system, and sanctions-screening instances already in the dataset.

cases.ungoverned_failure_mode: Model drops scope, converting 'not in the tax compliance database' into a claim the vendor has no compliance standing anywhere (e.g. 'has no compliance standing anywhere'), or into a claim about vendor registration generally.
